authority

Some APIs can be invoked only after user authorization and consent are obtained. These APIs are divided into multiple scopes based on the application scope. Users can authorize a scope. After a scope is authorized, all APIs corresponding to the scope can be directly used.

When this type of API is invoked:

  • If the user does not accept or reject the permission, a dialog box is displayed, asking the user to click Agree. The API can be invoked only after the user clicks Agree.
  • If the user has been authorized, the API can be directly invoked.
  • If the user has rejected the authorization, no dialog box is displayed. Instead, the API fails to be called back. Developers must be compatible with the scenario where users reject authorization.

Obtaining User Authorization Settings

A developer can use ma.getSetting to obtain the current authorization status of a user. The Settings page is displayed.

Open the setting page

You can control the authorization status of the Mini Program on the Mini Program setting page (menu in the upper right corner > Settings).

Developers can call ma.openSetting to open the settings page and instruct users to enable authorization.

Initiate an authorization request in advance

You can use ma.authorize to send an authorization request to a user before invoking an API that requires authorization.

Scope list

Scope API Description
scope.location ma.getLocation Precise geographical location
scope.camera cameracomponent, ma.scanCode, ma.chooseImage Camera
scope.photosAlbums ma.saveImageToPhotosAlbum, ma.scanCode, ma.chooseImage Reading and Writing Album

AuthSetting

Attribute

boolean scope.location

Indicates whether to authorize geographical locations. The ma.getLocation API is involved.

boolean scope.camera

Indicates whether to authorize the camera. The involved component is camera, and the APIs are ma.scanCode and ma.chooseImage.

boolean scope.photosAlbums

Indicates whether to authorize the user to read and write the album. The ma.saveImageToPhotosAlbum, ma.scanCode, and ma.chooseImage APIs are involved.
